| `anime_type` | `AnimeType` | not written | Runtime-only display type detected from DMI; not written to the file. |
| `system` | `Vec<ActionLoader>` | `[]` | Actions played by the `run_main_loop` D-Bus method. This is the base system sequence used by tools; it is not the boot animation. |
| `boot` | `Vec<ActionLoader>` | `[]` | Actions played while booting. `Default` is empty; a newly created file gets one sample action. |

| `display_enabled` | `bool` | `true` | Enable the display. |

| `off_when_unplugged` | `bool` | `true` | Turn the display off when external power is unplugged. |
| `off_when_suspended` | `bool` | `true` | Turn the display off when the laptop suspends. |
| `off_when_lid_closed` | `bool` | `true` | Turn the display off when the lid is closed. |
